start.text: First day on the job in IT. I fix computer problems and keep everyone's accounts safe. Hopefully today is a quiet one.
start.name: Joshua

B.text: IT desk, this is Joshua. How can I help?
B.name: Joshua

C.text: Hi, Joshua? It's Anna Reyes. Um... something weird is going on with my account.
C.name: Anna

D1.text: I got an email saying my password was changed. But I never changed it!
D1.name: Anna

D2.text: Yeah, the helpdesk got me back in this morning. But nobody can tell me who changed my password, or why.
D2.name: Anna

E.text: What if [b][color=red]somebody else[/color][/b] got into my account? It can open the company's pay records. That really scares me.
E.name: Anna

F.text: Okay, Anna, take a breath. I'll go through the records and figure out what happened.
F.name: Joshua

G.text: Thank you so much. Please let me know as soon as you find something!
G.name: Anna

H.text: Alright. Every email, sign-in and file leaves a record somewhere. I just have to know where to look.
H.name: Joshua

I.text: [b][color=green]4 clues[/color][/b] should be enough to show what really happened. Then I'll write it all up in my report.
I.name: Joshua
